left_hand_yoke.boost: left grip or a documented button fallback
left_hand_yoke.recenter: left menu button; seated calibration is repeatable

right_hand_spell.direction: right controller aim pose normalized into the existing camera/aim ABI
right_hand_spell.cast: right trigger invokes the existing validated cast command
right_hand_spell.spell_select: right thumbstick or world-space spell wheel
right_hand_spell.fallback: flat button/reticle path exists for every required action
right_hand_spell.hand_origin_throw: not part of the first slice

transforms_and_controls.tracking_loss: freeze local view, stop sending pose deltas, preserve Rust state, recover to stable view or safe pause
transforms_and_controls.handedness: left/right action maps are swappable without changing command semantics

comfort.roll: off by default; accessibility profile may cap visual roll
comfort.turning: 30-degree snap turn default; smooth turn is opt-in
comfort.vignette: enabled during boost, knockback and high angular velocity; adjustable
comfort.recenter: explicit seated recenter and restart-safe recenter
comfort.ui: world-space or wrist-space, focal distance and contrast tested; no eye-pinned flat HUD

budgets.frame_gate: p99 frame time <= the selected refresh budget for a representative flight/combat route; no sustained reprojection or dropped-frame burst
budgets.thermal_gate: no thermal-throttle or comfort-degrading sustained performance collapse during the soak

accept: lab package lock is editor-resolved and hash-recorded
empty OpenXR build starts and exits cleanly
PC frame, tick, allocation, memory, tracking, suspend and comfort gates pass
command stream and replay/state hashes match the flat Enhanced route
limit: runtime present but no connected headset/controller
any visual-only mismatch not yet shown to affect Rust commands or hashes
reject: XR packages or objects enter Exact
hand pose becomes an unvalidated gameplay authority
frame/comfort failure cannot be remediated without a rules fork
owner payload is bundled in a player or shared artifact

non_goals: DOSBox, original executable or original-binary oracle work
copying owner assets into a distributable player
standalone Quest support inferred from PC
hand-origin physical throwing in the first vertical slice
VoxelMode, Track S successor implementation, or Level 2 exporter work
